title: Mirabel and the Provision
author: August Ravensworth
blurb: Astrid Dravenmoor, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
